facilities.source: recreation.gov facility description ('drinking water, a dump station, flush toilets and hot showers'), amenities (Laundry Facilities) and notice 'Wifi is NOT provided at this campground', read 2026-11-24

note: Corps campground in the woods on a J. Percy Priest Lake point off Stewarts Ferry Pike, about 10 miles east of downtown Nashville; the west row looks through trees to the lake. The 14-night limit counts every campground on the lake together. No drive-throughs Friday to Sunday. --Claude
